findings: Collapsed the duplicate PR-template contract by making pull-request-template.md canonical and reducing pull-request-template-v2.md to a non-copyable alias.
Removed active Cargo and retired oya verifier instructions from the PR/done/review/ADR authoring surfaces instead of adding another explanatory layer.
PR evidence now points at Buck2 build/test/check targets plus Prow/Kubernetes-native oya-ci-required, matching the current monorepo lane-unlocker direction.
GitHub Actions is described as a shadow adapter, not permanent CI authority.

F3_adversarial.diagnostic_asserted: Targeted stale-reference scans reject Cargo/retired oya verifier/non-live oya-pr-review authority in the active PR template, PR checklist, done checklist, AGENTS PR-shape section, and ADR template.
findings: The previous template could lead agents to claim `./bin/oya verify --ci-required` or Cargo checks as canonical merge evidence despite Buck2/Prow policy.
The v2 alias previously carried a second full PR body that could drift independently.
Contributors now copy one PR template and see the same current merge-context wording used in root AGENTS guidance.
The required verification block names the concrete Buck2 targets used by the GitHub adapter checks.

Verification plan covers markdown/reference scans, agent-instruction inventory fence count, multispectrum evidence shape, repo-hygiene and Buck2 authority checks, plus remote GitHub adapter checks before merge.
